ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (32) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Поговорка» (pogovorka, 'saying') is rendered 'saying' rather than 'proverb'; Laozi's «не бывают» (ne byvayut, 'are not, as a rule') is kept as a plain 'are not' without the website's added 'never'. The second Voltaire attribution is printed without a final period, as in the Russian.
Source observation: [23] Attribution «*Вольтер*» lacks its final period (every other attribution has one); the English mirrors it.
Source observation: [26] «из желании» is ungrammatical (expected «из желания», 'from the desire'); translated as the evident sense.
